name: Titanium.UI.Shortcut
description:
Allows the creation of application shortcuts, which can be detected using
the `click` event from [Titanium.UI.Shortcut](api:Titanium.UI.Shortcut).

On iOS, shortcuts are only supported on a 3D Touch compatible device.
Use the [Titanium.UI.iOS.forceTouchSupported](api:Titanium.UI.iOS#forceTouchSupported) property to see if it's supported.

examples.title: Simple Shortcut Example

properties.name: items
properties.description: Array of shortcut items that were added to the app via the [Titanium.UI.Shortcut.add](api:Titanium.UI.Shortcut#add) method.

methods.name: add
methods.summary: Adds a shortcut item to the application.

methods.name: getById
methods.summary: Fetches a shortcut item by its unique string identifier.
methods.description:
Returns a shortcut item with a matching string [id](api:Titanium.UI.ShortcutItem#id).
Returns `null` if a match was not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.summary: Identifier of shortcut item to obtain.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Removes the given shortcut item from the application.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.summary: Removes all shortcut items from the application.

events.name: click
events.summary: Fired when a [Titanium.UI.ShortcutItem](api:Titanium.UI.ShortcutItem) was clicked on.
